relevance.why: Foundational, free, and directly about building shippable agent products -- exactly the shape of apps we build with Claude Code. Factors 2, 3, 4, 8, 9, 10 and 11 map onto Claude Code skill/subagent design and onto any agent feature inside our apps.

implement_score.why: One hour to read; then fold the factors into our CLAUDE.md / agent-architecture checklist (own prompts, structured-output tools, small focused agents, human-in-the-loop via tool calls, meet users in SMS/WhatsApp). No cost.
